phase2_hypothesis_decision.specific_weakness: No topology-localized BCL weakness is supported by the seed-42 evidence.
phase2_hypothesis_decision.candidate_intervention: Stop this BCL-specific direction at Phase 2.
phase2_hypothesis_decision.candidate_intervention_reason: Few-class gain heterogeneity alone leaves the mechanism unresolved. The pre-specified class direction and matched Tail-to-Head contrasts provide insufficient stable localization.

gradient_diagnostics: All gradient probes use the fixed LT TRAIN-only probe cache. The common-input probe uses model.eval() and the same v2 feature tensor for LC/BCL gradients. The native_three_view_train probe concatenates v1/v2/v3 in one train-mode forward and reports W_y, feature, backbone-parameter and input gradients; BatchNorm running buffers are restored after each diagnostic batch.
margin_data_sources: Training margins use the fixed five-per-class LT TRAIN probe. TEST margins are computed read-only from saved final logits; no TEST autograd or gradient calculation is performed.
head_tail_diagnostics: C[a->b] = P(prediction=b | true=a); Head-to-Tail and Tail-to-Head are separate. DID = mean(delta C | same CIFAR-100 coarse superclass) - mean(delta C | different superclass), with delta C = BCL - LC-only. DINO Top-K union is reported as a separate exogenous relation when available.

oracle_menu_not_executed.prototype: replace W-derived prototypes with balanced reference-feature prototypes
oracle_menu_not_executed.relation: suppress or down-weight same-superclass negative prototypes
oracle_menu_not_executed.gradient: project BCL gradient against LC only when conflicting: g2* = g2 - min(0, g1^T g2)/(||g1||^2 + eps) * g1

stage_gate: Repeat the paired comparison across additional seeds before claiming a stable effect.
Gradient direction/norm, margin change, directional confusion change, and Many/Medium/Few/Overall performance must tell a coherent mechanism-consistent story.
Only then run the Oracle aligned with the observed mechanism; do not run all Oracles as a fishing expedition.
Stop if the Oracle has no stable benefit or improves one group only by sacrificing other groups.
numeric_thresholds: No numeric go/no-go threshold was pre-registered; do not invent one after seeing results.
